seoTitle: Page Speed Test for Mobile and Desktop
metaDescription: Run a Google Lighthouse lab test for a public URL and review performance metrics and suggestions.
intro: Run a Google Lighthouse lab test for a public URL and review performance metrics and suggestions.
aboutTitle: What does the Page Speed Test measure?
about: It requests a Lighthouse lab run for the selected device mode. The score and timings describe that run under simulated conditions. They can vary between tests.
exampleTitle: Compare two mobile runs after an image update
example: Run the same URL in mobile mode before and after publishing the change. Compare repeated runs and check whether the largest contentful paint timing improves.

faqs.question: Is this score real visitor data?
faqs.answer: This tool reports lab measurements. Use field data where available to understand how actual visitors experience the page.
